title: Dorsal Hand Stroking
summary: Very light longitudinal movements are made between bony and tendon structures.
goal: Gently work the back of the hand.
startingPosition: The hand is supported with the back facing upward.
instructions: Move from the wrist toward the fingers.
direction: From wrist toward the finger bases.
tips: Use less pressure than on the palm.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
